rule: Every number Scribe's gates, auto-merge rule, self-healing loops and vendor exit compare against. Split from registry.json on purpose: the registry says which repositories are in scope and who approved what, this file says how good a page has to be, and the two change for entirely different reasons. Nothing here is written at run time — a threshold moves only by PR, so a cycle can never lower the bar it failed. Checked by `npm run validate:docgen-registry`.

hard._: Any failure blocks the page. Recomputed from the PR diff by the docs-wiki-eval CI job, which does not trust the daemon's own report.

soft._: Scored, not fatal. A page below one of these still opens a PR; it just does not merge itself. judge_calibration_max_delta is the bar the local 14b judge has to clear against Haiku 4.5 on the golden pages before its score is allowed to fail anything; scripts/docgen/calibrate.mjs measures it and usr/docgen/calibration.json records the measurement.

automerge._: Clauses 3 and 8 of the eight-condition rule in design.md section 6. The other six clauses are conditions rather than numbers and live in code.

exit._: Task 4.1. A repository leaves the vendor only once it has proved it does not need the baseline any more.

loops._: The self-healing constants from design.md section 8. Hours rather than cycles wherever a watchdog reads the value, because the daemon's schedule can change and a wall-clock ceiling cannot be quietly widened by rescheduling. pr_batch_interval_hours is the exception that is not about healing: a cycle that finds work waits this long since the repository's last docs:auto PR before opening another, so a fourteen-repository fleet does not put a PR gate on the single self-hosted runner every thirty minutes.
